life_approximation.duration: (last clean matched review - first clean matched review).total_seconds()/86400; zero for one timestamp, null if no reviews
life_approximation.cutoff: max parseable civil date in full source review file
life_approximation.limitations: Review dates approximate opening/closing. Open businesses remain censored. True opening, closing and age at delayed entry are unknown; no lifetime before first review is invented.

sentiment.selection_metric: macro F1 on business-disjoint held-out test; comparison of two models

analytics.minimum_justification: ten aggregated business-years to avoid ranking near-zero-exposure groups; operational threshold, not a confidence interval
analytics.category_rule: alphabetically first non-family source tag; population remains Restaurants
analytics.benchmark_operation: both category and geohash RDD reductions with collection and independent DataFrame equality checks; repartition included
analytics.benchmark_source: 16944 observed business lifetimes, MEMORY_AND_DISK materialized before timing
analytics.warmup: one unmeasured pair of reductions per partition/mode configuration
